_comment: Maps each check to the exact clause it enforces. verified=true: the clause was read in the source document. Sources are listed under 'documents'. Georgian guides are in Georgian; section numbers refer to the original.

GE-XS2A.title: Georgian NextGenPSD2 XS2A Implementation Guide 0.8.RC3 (Banking Association of Georgia, 12 Sep 2022)

GE-IAA.title: Georgian Identification, Authentication and Authorization Guide 0.8.RC1 (Banking Association of Georgia, 30 Sep 2021)

GE-JWS.title: Georgian JWS Implementation Guide for Open Finance 0.5.RC1 (Banking Association of Georgia, 6 Sep 2021)

BG-IG.title: Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 XS2A Implementation Guidelines 1.3.11 (24 Sep 2021). The Georgian guide references 1.3.9; the sections cited here (4.12, 4.13, 14.x) keep the same numbering, as the Georgian guide's own cross-references confirm.

FAPI1.title: OpenID FAPI Part 1 as referenced by GE-IAA (13) (Financial-grade API - Part 1: Read-Only API Security Profile; final text published as FAPI 1.0 Part 1: Baseline, 12 March 2021); required by GE-IAA §6.1

spec.available.note: API structure must follow the Berlin Group framework; a machine-readable spec is how TPPs check it.

refs: OAS §4.7.12 (parameter object: path parameters are required)

spec.x-request-id-required.note: Every API request must carry X-Request-ID of type UUID.

live.schema.note: Compared with the bank's own published specification.

live.error-format.note: Either variant is allowed: tppMessages (category ERROR/WARNING + message code) or RFC 7807 with a message code.

live.error-code-status.note: Each message code has a fixed HTTP status.

live.with-balance.note: withBalance=true with a balance consent: balances must be returned; without it: must not.

live.without-balance.note: Account list without withBalance=true: balances must never be returned.

live.account-links.note: balances/transactions links are mandatory when the consent covers them, forbidden otherwise.

live.booking-status.note: booked, pending and both must be supported.

rel.availability.note: Neither standard sets numeric availability targets; thresholds are assumed until NBG publishes them.

lat.p95.note: No latency requirement in the Georgian or Berlin Group documents; threshold is an assumption until NBG publishes indicators.

sec.discovery.note: GE-IAA §5.6 requires the TPP to verify hyperlinks and the authenticity of the OAuth2 server metadata (RFC 8414); it does not itself oblige the bank to publish a discovery document. Missing metadata is reported because a TPP then has nothing to verify or configure from.

sec.client-auth.note: Client authentication and token issuance must use the QWAC certificates (RFC 8705).

sec.pkce-methods.note: GE-IAA §6.1 requires full FAPI Part 1 compliance; FAPI 5.2.2-7: shall require RFC 7636 with S256.

sec.message-signing.note: JWS seal (x-jws-signature + Digest) on every request and response; the Berlin Group signature form must not be used. Sandboxes: one unsigned read-only call; mock: warning only (its spec relaxes the headers).

sec.hsts.note: Not required by the Georgian or Berlin Group documents; transport hardening best practice.

refs: GE-XS2A §5 (TPP-ASPSP channel is mutually authenticated server-to-server)
sec.cors.note: No explicit CORS rule in the standard; flagged as best practice.

sec.token-lifetime.note: No lifetime is mandated; reported for information.

data.iban.note: GE IBAN: 22 characters, SWIFT IBAN registry.

data.amount-format.note: String, up to 14 significant figures, dot as decimal separator, minus for negatives.

data.balance-types.note: Allowed: closingBooked, expected, openingBooked, interimAvailable, interimBooked, forwardAvailable, nonInvoiced.

data.tx-window.note: Booked may include items certain to post in the current banking day (§9.3.6); banks book on Tbilisi dates, so one day after dateTo is tolerated.

refs: GE-XS2A §9.3.6.1 (entryReferenceFrom paging; the only case where the identifier may change)
data.tx-ids.note: entryReference is mandatory on every transaction and unique within the consent across booked and pending (§9.3.6.6); transactionId is conditional. Card-account transactions are checked by cardTransactionId.

ai.status.note: Informational: AI layer status, enforces no clause.

data.balance-minimum.note: List: at least one interim (interimAvailable preferred). Details: interimAvailable + interimBooked. Balances: closingBooked + interimAvailable. Card-account balances (/v1/card-accounts/{id}/balances): every balance returned for an account, so closingBooked + interimAvailable (§9.4.7). Card balances (/v1/cards/{id}/balances): at least interimAvailable.

pis.status.note: transactionStatus uses the ISO 20022 code list.

pis.echo.note: The payment resource must reflect what was initiated.

refs: BG-IG §14.11 (RESOURCE_UNKNOWN 403 for a non-account resource in path)

pis.neg.ais-token.note: A token is valid only for the service and resource it was issued for.

pis.recurring.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

pis.recurring-response.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

pis.recurring.neg.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

pis.deferred.note: requestedExecutionDate is defined in §8.2.8; the v2 deferred-payments service itself is a later addition.

v2.consent.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions. Consent mechanics follow §9.2.

v2.authorize.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.consent-status.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.consent-delete.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.savings.list.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.loans.list.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.savings.balances.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.loans.balances.note: Service added to the Georgian framework after XS2A guide 0.8.RC3; no clause in the documents provided. Checked against Berlin Group conventions.

v2.neg.ais-consent.note: A consent grants only the access it lists.

rel.flow-outage.note: Availability; no numeric clause in the standards provided. Threshold is an assumption.

sec.digest-valid.note: Digest is mandatory (§7) and must equal SHA-256 of the body, Base64 (§9.4); verifiers compare it (§10.6).

sec.jws-header.note: b64, sigT, sigD and the certificate reference are mandatory protected header fields (§6).

lat.samples.note: Statistical guardrail, not a standard requirement.

spec.standard-version.note: Informational. No clause governs info.version; §7.1 puts the standard version in the URL (judged by spec.version-path) and §2.1.1 sets 0.8.RC1 as the minimum, older versions may run in parallel.

spec.amount-type.note: amount: String, the decimal separator is a dot.

refs: BG-IG §14 (data types: Max35Text, IBAN, ISO 4217 codes)
GE-JWS §6 (typ: not recommended; JOSE if present)
BG-IG §6.3.1.1 (consent on dedicated accounts: access.accounts / balances / transactions)
BG-IG §13 (OAuth2 as pre-step vs OAuth2 SCA)

sec.response-signature-valid.note: Signature value checked with the key in x5c[0]; trust in the QSealC chain is judged separately.

refs: GE-JWS §6 (x5c: one entry, the signing certificate)
GE-JWS §5 (sigT more than 60 s old: must not be processed)
GE-JWS §5 (sigT more than 2 s ahead: must not be processed)

live.no-confirmation-link.note: Redirect SCA: the bank must not return a confirmation link.

pis.idempotency.note: X-Request-ID lets the bank tell a repeated request from a new one.

pis.bulk.note: Bulk payments: listed by NBG as in use.

pis.multiple-recurring.note: Added by NBG after the 0.8.RC3 guide; judged against the bank's documented schema.

pis.secured.note: Judged against the bank's documented schema.

spec.vrp.note: Informational. NBG lists variable recurring payments (VRPs) for sweeping as available but not yet in practical use (NBG, Open Banking in Georgia); GE-XS2A 0.8.RC3 predates the service and no published clause fixes its API.

ux.consent-journey.note: Informational, not scored. No clause limits the steps of the SCA journey; screens, typed values, choices and TPP API steps are counted to compare banks (consent journey analysis).
